title: Greek Chicken Wrap
description: A simple and flavorful wrap filled with juicy chicken, crunchy veggies, and tangy tzatziki sauce. Perfect for a quick and easy lunch on the go.
instructions: Season chicken breast with salt and pepper.
Grill chicken for 5-6 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Let chicken rest for 5 minutes before slicing.
Warm wrap by wrapping it in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Spread tzatziki sauce on the wrap, leaving a small border around the edges.
Add sliced chicken, tomato, red onion, cucumber, and feta cheese on top of the sauce.
Fold the bottom edge of the wrap up over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll up the wrap to form a tight cylinder.
